result: Backend tests and frontend build pass, but UI integration has a critical owner-navigation defect: /api/auth/me returns only csrfToken while App.tsx requires me.role==='owner' to render Accounts/Audit, so owner users cannot reach either screen. Navigation currently shows Accounts/Audit to every role, but non-owners render no content and do not receive a clear 403 state. Account controls otherwise use CSRF-aware api actions; role-change, password-reset, and delete confirmations exist, owner self-protection is enforced by hiding owner controls and backend checks, audit pagination/outcome styling exists, and password/Factorio token fields are not displayed in account/audit UI. User creation has no confirmation prompt.

evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing SignalR Rollup annotation warnings.
GET /api/auth/me response contains only csrfToken; it does not return uid, name, or role.
App stores /api/auth/me as Me but renders Accounts/Audit only when me.role==='owner'; navigation unconditionally includes both tabs, making owner screens unreachable and non-owner tabs blank.
Role changes, password resets, and deletes have confirmations; owner row controls are hidden; audit log supports newest-first beforeId pagination and outcome colors.
Mutating account actions flow through api(), which adds X-CSRF-Token; password inputs are type=password and no hashes/tokens are rendered.
Backend owner filter returns and audits 403 for non-owner users, including self-protection through account service/backend checks.

next_slice.summary: Fix /api/auth/me to return role (and preferably uid/name), conditionally hide owner navigation for non-owners, show a clear forbidden state for direct non-owner tab access, and consider confirming account creation. Then rerun UI/backend QA.

blockers: Owner Accounts/Audit UI is unreachable because /api/auth/me omits role.
Non-owner navigation exposes owner tabs that render blank rather than a clear forbidden state.
